correctness.rationale: Token folding proves the >=r bound. Odd-prime LTE proves H(a)-H(b) has exactly the same M-adic congruence relation as a-b; this yields a bijective exponent lift and a weight-r witness for every k. Legendre gives nu2(C(2n,n))=s2(n); for each odd p an explicit base-p 0/1-digit multiple has zero carries. Universal quantifiers follow from algebra, not finite checking.

A complete 2^r-1 power-tower weight formula is proved via an invertible exponent-lifting map; closely relevant original full texts, the OEIS invariant, past claims, and published-finding corpus semantic hits contain no identified statement covering this exact for-all-r,k theorem or its infinite fixed-divisor consequence. value.rationale: The exact minimal binary weight is a known natural arithmetic invariant, but a complete all-power formula for every Mersenne base has motivated structural significance: modular height grows arbitrarily while the sparse optimum stays fixed. The exponent lift is constructive and uses one adjustable bit. The exact gcd over infinitely many central binomial coefficients is a natural independent arithmetic interpretation (a corollary), not a manufactured arbitrary slice.
